## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Landing hero copy, Pebblebrook Tea Co. website, UK audience.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website" | On the policy list, word for word. Source is the October 2026 review export, so it's current. |
| "Organic" | Backed by the Soil Association certificate on file (renewed 2026). |
| "plastic-free bags" | Backed by the EN 13432 supplier certificate. |
| "packed by hand in Bristol" | Policy row: "Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol." |

**Regulated claims:** No health, money, legal, children or price content. The only environmental wording is "plastic-free", which the policy covers. There are no superlatives, guarantees or fake urgency.

**House style:** The copy is plain and warm enough, with no banned words and no AI tells. UK spelling is fine. Score is about 90, so no rewrite is needed.

**Disclosure:** This is our own landing page, with no partner, affiliate, gifted or AI-labelled content. No label is needed.

**Fixed:** Nothing, no changes made.

**Needs a decision (optional):** The policy says "every *tin*" is packed by hand. The sentence reads as if the bags are also hand-packed. If the bags come in boxes or pouches that aren't hand-packed, change it to "Organic loose leaf, packed by hand in Bristol, and plastic-free tea bags." If they are hand-packed, no change is needed.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). The copy passes the checks, but it can't go live until Sam gives an explicit yes to this exact text. I haven't recorded any approval.
